title: Meet Manu Rishi Chadha, the Filmfare-Winning Writer Who Plays Musharraf in Netflix's Operation Safed Sagar
excerpt: The veteran character actor and dialogue writer takes on the most dramatic role of his career in Netflix India's most expensive production.
body:
• Veteran actor Manu Rishi Chadha plays Pakistan's General Pervez Musharraf in Netflix's Operation Safed Sagar, the streamer's most expensive Indian production at ₹215 crore ($24 million).
  • The Filmfare Award-winning dialogue writer transforms into the Pakistani military leader orchestrating the Kargil War's covert infiltration in the six-episode series.
  • Operation Safed Sagar, which premiered August 7, is based on the Indian Air Force's high-altitude mission during the 1999 Kargil conflict and holds an 8.8/10 rating.
  • The ensemble cast includes Siddharth, Jimmy Shergill, Adil Hussain, Dia Mirza, and Vinay Pathak as Nawaz Sharif.

In Netflix's Operation Safed Sagar, the sprawling Kargil War drama that premiered on August 7, the scenes inside Pakistan's military establishment carry a tension that matches anything happening in the Indian Air Force cockpits. That's largely down to Manu Rishi Chadha, who plays General Pervez Musharraf — the architect of the covert operation that drew India into one of its most dangerous military confrontations.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=vqV3xfeb4SQ

Chadha, known primarily as a character actor and one of Hindi cinema's sharpest dialogue writers, takes on the most dramatic role of his career: portraying the Pakistani general whose brinkmanship nearly escalated a regional border conflict into full-scale war between two nuclear-armed nations.

From Delhi Theatre to Netflix's Biggest Indian Production

Born in New Delhi in 1971, Chadha trained for six years under theater director Arvind Gaur with the Asmita Theatre Group, performing in over 40 plays ranging from Girish Karnad's Rakt Kalyan to Shakespeare's Julius Caesar. He moved to Mumbai in 2001 and made his film debut in Mani Ratnam's Saathiya (2002) in a small role as a doctor.

His breakthrough came not in front of the camera but behind it. As the dialogue writer for Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye! (2008), Dibakar Banerjee's darkly comic crime film, Chadha won both the Filmfare Best Dialogue Award and the IIFA Best Dialogue Award. He went on to write dialogues for films including Aisha, Band Baaja Baaraat, and Salman Khan's Tubelight.

The Musharraf Challenge

Operation Safed Sagar depicts the Indian Air Force's role during the 1999 Kargil War — specifically the 47-day air operation that began on May 26, 1999, involving fighter jets, attack helicopters, and UAVs targeting Pakistani positions along the Line of Control. The series follows the Golden Arrows squadron, led by Wing Commander B.S. "Tony" Dhanoa (Jimmy Shergill) and Squadron Leader Ajay Ahuja (Siddharth).

On the Pakistani side, Chadha's Musharraf is the strategic counterpoint — the general whose plans to seize Indian positions at extreme altitudes gradually unravel as international pressure mounts. Vinay Pathak plays Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif, setting up a parallel narrative of the political tensions within Pakistan's own leadership during the conflict.

"Some chapters in our nation's history demand more than remembrance — they deserve to be brought to life with honesty and scale."

— Sanjay Routray, Producer, Matchbox Shots

Scale and Ambition

According to Bloomberg, Operation Safed Sagar was made with a budget of ₹215 crore ($24 million), making it Netflix's most expensive Indian production to date. The shoot spanned 115 days across more than 100 locations, including operational Indian Air Force bases at altitudes exceeding 16,000 feet. Netflix hired 200 cast and crew members and 4,000 daily workers, with more than ₹49 crore ($5 million) spent on visual effects by 15 India-based VFX studios.

The series was co-created by Abhijeet Singh Parmar and Kushal Srivastava, with Srivastava drawing on his experience in the Indian Air Force. Director Oni Sen, known for the thriller series Asur, leads the production.

A Versatile Career

Chadha's filmography of over 50 credits reflects an actor who gravitates toward ensemble comedies and middle-class dramas — Pati Patni Aur Woh, Angrezi Medium, Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan, Hum Do Hamare Do. Playing a real-life military dictator on a geopolitical stage marks a sharp departure, and the kind of casting that makes Operation Safed Sagar's ensemble — which also includes Adil Hussain as Air Marshal Vinod Patney, Mahesh Manjrekar as Air Chief Marshal, and Dia Mirza as Kamalpreet Dhanoa — feel deliberately unpredictable.

The series is streaming on Netflix worldwide, with all six episodes available.

nri_angle: The Kargil War holds deep significance for the Indian diaspora, and Netflix's global availability makes this the most accessible dramatization of the IAF's role for NRIs worldwide.
